description: Put a question for the person on the call's Decision Board (shown as #number with buttons; the person can also answer by voice, also freely). Meant for every question the person decides: yes/no, A/B, an approval, picking a value. A question only spoken via say leaves no button and no decision event. Without options it is a yes/no question (buttons Yes/No); options: 2 to 3, max 40 characters each, recommend = index of the recommended option. question: max 160 characters. Longer or more: 422, never cut. Returns id and number. The answer arrives later as a `next` event {type: decision, id, number, verdict: yes|no|option|other|unclear, option?, text? (their own answer, or for unclear the request to ask it again more simply), by}. context: the background the person opens with the arrow next to the question on the card and Delta uses to explain it, only what the reader needs, nothing internal, one short line per part (Was / Warum / Bei Ja / Bei Nein, or What / Why / If yes / If no; lines starting with '- ' show as bullet points); faq: the 3 likely follow-up questions with prepared answers, shown below it as questions and answers. Without context and faq the card shows no arrow; without context and 3 faq the result carries `warnings` (no error). Change an open one with id plus new fields, remove it with id and delete true. no_question = id of a question_check event, alone: confirms that line was no question to the person. Decisions marked auto (detected automatically) are answered only by a human; changing or deleting them gives 403. card_type done = completion report instead of a question: title (whole sentence, max 160), summary (max 600), evidence [{label, url?}] (max 5, http(s) only), live (bool), ask (optional follow-up question); no question/options/recommend/context/faq (422). The server shows the single button Seen; it never counts as an open decision. Same sender and same title while unseen updates that card. When the person marks it, `next` gets {type: decision, card_type: done, id, number, verdict: seen, title, text? (answer to ask), by, answered_by, answered_via, answered_by_label}.

label.description: What it proves, max 80 chars (e.g. 'All 412 tests green').
label.title: Label

url.description: Optional http(s) link (PR, CI run, live page).
url.title: Url

q.description: A likely follow-up question of the person, max 200 chars.
q.title: Q

ask.description: card_type done: optional follow-up question (one sentence ending with ?), answered in a text field next to Seen.
ask.title: Ask

card_type.description: decision (default) or done: a completion report ('work finished') with title, summary, evidence, live, ask instead of question/options; the person only marks it Seen, no decision.
card_type.title: Card Type

context.description: Background (max 1500 chars) the person opens with the arrow next to the question; Delta explains from it. Only reader-relevant, one line per part: Was / Warum / Bei Ja / Bei Nein.
context.title: Context

evidence.description: card_type done: up to 5 proofs [{label, url?}], url only http(s).
evidence.title: Evidence

faq.description: Up to 3 likely follow-up questions with prepared answers [{q, a}] (max 200 chars each), hidden, for the voicebot. Without context and 3 faq the result carries `warnings`.
faq.title: Faq

id.description: Id of an open decision to change or delete.
id.title: Id

live.description: card_type done: true = it is live (marked on the card).
live.title: Live

no_question.description: Id of a question_check event: confirms the line was no question to the person (pass it alone).
no_question.title: No Question

options.description: Optional: 2 to 3 answer options, max 40 characters each; leave out for a yes/no question.
options.title: Options

question.description: The question, max 160 chars (required when creating).
question.title: Question

summary.description: card_type done: short report, max 600 chars.
summary.title: Summary

title.description: card_type done: what is finished, one whole sentence, max 160 chars, no bare numbers.
title.title: Title
